signals.headline: Launched AI product and platform publicly
signals.quote: Big day! The Reach AI OS to win AI Search is officially live!
signals.how_to_use: Reference their official AI platform launch on Product Hunt and LinkedIn as a natural entry point to discuss tailored AI Liability and Tech E&O coverage for new AI products.
signals.found_by: Searches news for launch announcements and reads the company's blog and product pages.
signals.why_it_matters: AI output is a new kind of liability, and buyers now ask about it in security reviews.
signals.angle: Customers ask how AI output is covered. Ask whether AI liability is part of their Tech E&O today.

signals.headline: Hiring in NY while headquartered in Lisbon, Portugal
signals.quote: Open roles located in the US on the company's careers page: Founding Growth Marketer (NYC or Lisbon); Founding GTM Engineer (NYC or Lisbon); Account Executive (NYC); Talent & Operations Lead (NYC or Lisbon); Content Marketer (SEO & AI Search) (Lisbon, NYC or remote); Growth Strategist (SEO & AEO Specialist) (Lisbon, NYC or remote).
signals.how_to_use: A first US employee means workers' comp in that state from day one, and usually a US entity to hold the policy. Ask whether that is set up for the US hires.
signals.found_by: Reads the location of every open role and counts the distinct US states. If the company has no job board, its own careers page is read instead. For a company based abroad, one US role is enough.
signals.why_it_matters: Workers' comp is required state by state, from the first employee in each one. Headcount growth also raises employment-practices risk.
signals.angle: Each new state with an employee needs workers' comp there. Ask whether coverage follows the hiring plan.

signals.headline: Executive posted about hitting ARR milestones and scaling growth
signals.quote: Four months ago we hit $500K ARR. Today we just crossed $1M.
signals.how_to_use: Acknowledge their rapid growth from $500K to $1M ARR when discussing scaling insurance needs as headcount and operations expand.
signals.found_by: Runs one search per top contact for their recent public posts, interviews and announcements, and keeps only results that name both the person and the company.
signals.why_it_matters: It is the most personal opener available: something that person chose to say in public.
signals.angle: Open with what they said and where, then connect it to the insurance requirement it creates.

rejected.reason: No priced funding round announced in the last 90 days; revenue is driven by ARR growth and prior founding background.
Mentioning case studies and working with clients is part of their standard business model rather than a new enterprise compliance or dedicated enterprise hiring shift within the window.
